author: Huawei
description:
How do you modernize core IT without disrupting live operations? Telecom Argentina's Guillermo Loyola calls it "changing a plane engine mid-flight." In this #TransformTalks interview with #HuaweiCloud's Mark Chen, he explains why a hybrid multicloud approach—balancing private infrastructure with public cloud flexibility—is the smart bet for AI-powered services and regional growth.

Watch to learn their insights in the latest #Huawei Transform Talks: https://bit.ly/4uqcUcy #ThisIsHuawei
title: Why Telecom Argentina is Betting on Hybrid Multicloud and AI
